At a young age (~4 years old) one of my extended family members would die off every other year like clockwork (natural causes). Right when I would start to get over one death, another one would follow. I would constantly ask questions: Why did they die? Will I die? What happens after we die? etc. I was young and naive, so death was very confusing to me and I was easily impressionable.

Most of my family is religious to some extent, so the frequent answer that I would receive was that we "go to heaven". My parents eventually started taking us to church once a week. They told us a bunch of stories, what we should believe, how to get into heaven, etc. but one thing that I was told repeatedly was that "if you don't believe in Jesus (or accept him as your savior) you won't make it into Heaven." I blindly accepted this as fact, but as I got older (and started to learn science) the stories started to fall apart.

I began to realize that humans have existed long before Jesus was ever born and that all the stories in the Bible were NOT written by Jesus/God, but over the course of hundreds of years by other humans. I couldn't help but remember a game I use to play in Elementary school called telephone (aka: Chinese Whispers). How many of the stories in the religious text had been transformed over the thousands of years and multiple translations? I can't trust a message passed down through a small group of people over the course of 5 minutes let alone 2+ thousand years. How could "Heaven" be "paradise" if my best friend (who was Jewish) wouldn't make it into "Heaven" as well? How could "Heaven" be "paradise" if my mother, father, or one of my siblings ignorantly sinned and ended up not making it into "Heaven" as well?
